welcome.Subtitle: Free study tools for smarter and faster learning
welcome.block1: From lecture notes to messy doodles – turn anything into interactive flashcards, quick tests, and visual study sets. STUDO keeps it light, fast, and focused, so you spend less time organising and more time actually learning.
welcome.block2: I'm Charles, a full-time student who got tired of apps that were either paywalled, bloated, or just slow. So I built STUDO: a tool where every feature has a purpose and nothing gets in the way of studying.
welcome.block3: Whether it's vocab, formulas, or entire chapters, STUDO adapts to your study style. Personalised practice modes and revision sessions make it easier to remember what matters most. And soon, you'll be able to carry it all in your pocket with the upcoming iOS app.

studosets.block1_studyset: A Studoset is the core of your learning experience: a collection of terms and definitions you can master through different modes
studosets.block2_studyset: Each Studoset contains terms and their definitions
studosets.block3_studyset: Create your own sets, import existing ones, or collaborate with others
studosets.block4_studyset: Use the same set across all study modes

visualsets.block1_visualset: A Visualset lets you study by linking definitions to pins on an image — perfect for anatomy, maps, and diagrams
visualsets.block2_visualset: Instead of just text terms, you upload an image
visualsets.block3_visualset: Each identify on the image acts as the term
visualsets.block4_visualset: To every identify, you attach the correct definition
visualsets.block5_visualset: Use your Visualset in Identify or Point

ai.block2_ai: Upload a vocabulary list, glossary, or lecture notes and turn them into a Studoset
ai.block3_ai: Snap a photo of a textbook page or diagram and let AI detect the terms
ai.block4_ai: AI cleans up the data into ready-to-use pairs
ai.block5_ai: Generated sets work across all modes

learn.block1_learn: An interactive study mode that quizzes you until every term is mastered.
learn.block2_learn: Type your answer - no multiple choice
learn.block3_learn: Master each term after two correct recalls
learn.block4_learn: Build long-term memory through active learning

speedy.block1_speedy: A timed quiz mode with rounds that push you to recall terms under pressure
speedy.block2_speedy: Beat the timer in every round
speedy.block3_speedy: Wrong answers move to the next round
speedy.block4_speedy: Clear all terms to win the session

flashcards.block1_flashcard: Quickly review terms and definitions with interactive flashcards
flashcards.block2_flashcard: Swipe or flip to reveal answers
flashcards.block4_flashcard: Shuffle and repeat until you're confident

identify.title_identify:
Recognize the parts,
Understand the whole
identify.block1_identify: Identify by typing the correct terms for each pin — ideal for anatomy, maps, diagrams, and more
identify.block2_identify: Go through pins one by one
identify.block4_identify: Missed pins return later until you master them

point.block1_point: Indicate the correct pin on the image based on the given definition
point.block2_point: You are given a definition as the task
point.block3_point: Point to the correct location on the image
point.block4_point: Incorrect choices will return until you master them

about-us.title: About Us
about-us.intro1: Hi! I'm Charles – a full-time student and the only engineer working on STUDO. This app started from my own frustration with existing study tools: too many useless features, too many paywalls, and too little focus on what actually helps you learn.
about-us.intro2: I wanted something clean, fast, and distraction-free – so I decided to build it myself. What started as a personal project has grown into something I'm genuinely proud of, and I'm excited to share it with students everywhere.
about-us.intro3: STUDO is designed to be exactly what you need to study smarter: no hidden costs, no unnecessary extras, just powerful, intuitive tools that actually make a difference. Every feature exists because it solves a real problem students face – nothing more, nothing less.
about-us.storyText1: It all started during exam season. I was juggling multiple subjects, trying different study apps, and getting more frustrated by the day. Some apps were bloated with features I'd never use. Others locked basic functionality behind expensive subscriptions. And most of them felt like they were designed by people who hadn't been students in years.
about-us.storyText2: So I opened my laptop and started coding. The first version was rough – just flashcards and a simple quiz mode. But it worked. And more importantly, it worked the way I needed it to. From there, STUDO kept growing, shaped by my own study needs and feedback from friends who started using it too.
about-us.differentText: There are plenty of study apps out there. Here's why STUDO stands out:
about-us.different1: Studosets – our unique approach to flashcards with multiple study modes built in
about-us.different2: Visualsets – learn with images using pin-the-label and point-to-answer features
about-us.different3: Speedy mode – race against the clock to test your knowledge under pressure
about-us.different4: No ads, no distractions – just you and your study material
about-us.different5: 100% free core features – because learning shouldn't have a paywall
about-us.listenText1: Because we're still small, your feedback has a direct impact on the app's future. If you have an idea, request, or even a complaint, I genuinely want to hear it. Every feature request gets read, and many of them make it into the app.
about-us.listenText2: STUDO grows with its users – and every suggestion helps us make it better for everyone. This isn't just a product; it's a community of students helping each other study smarter.
about-us.goingText1: Right now, STUDO is a small, independent project. But the goal is big: to become the go-to study app for students everywhere, without sacrificing simplicity or accessibility.
about-us.goingText2: With your support, we can scale while keeping our core mission intact – making studying smarter, fairer, and stress-free. We're not trying to be everything to everyone. We're trying to be the best at helping you learn.
about-us.iosTitle: Exciting News – iOS App Coming Soon
about-us.iosText1: We're currently working on the first official STUDO iOS app! This will bring all the core features to your iPhone and iPad, with the same focus on speed, simplicity, and distraction-free studying.
about-us.iosText2: Study on the bus, in the library, or right before an exam – wherever you are, STUDO will be there. Stay tuned for the release – it's closer than you think.
about-us.valuesIntro: Everything we build is guided by these core principles:
about-us.value1Text: every feature is built with real student needs in mind, not corporate metrics
about-us.value2Text: learning should be accessible to everyone, regardless of budget
about-us.value3Text: your input directly shapes what we build next
about-us.value4Text: we'd rather do five things brilliantly than fifty things poorly
about-us.value5Text: your study data is yours – we don't sell it or use it for ads
about-us.teamText1: Right now, STUDO is a one-person operation. I handle the design, development, testing, and support – all while being a full-time student myself. It's a lot, but it means I truly understand what students need.
about-us.teamText2: As STUDO grows, the team might too. But for now, when you reach out, you're talking directly to the person who built the app. That's something I'm proud of.
about-us.thanksText: To everyone who has used STUDO, shared it with friends, or sent feedback – thank you. You're the reason this project exists. Every time someone tells me STUDO helped them ace an exam or made studying less stressful, it reminds me why I started this in the first place.

intro.welcome: Welcome to STUDO. Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our platform. STUDO is operated from Belgium and complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Belgian privacy laws.
intro.agreement: By using STUDO, you agree to the collection and use of information as described in this policy. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

whoAreWe.title: 1. Who Are We?
whoAreWe.description: STUDO is a digital learning platform designed to help students study more effectively. We are the data controller responsible for your personal data.

provided.title: 2.1 Data You Provide
provided.description: When you create an account or use STUDO, you may provide:

items.name: Name or username
items.password: Password (securely hashed, never stored in plain text)
items.content: Study content you create (studosets, visualsets, notes)

automatic.title: 2.2 Data Collected Automatically
automatic.description: When you use STUDO, we automatically collect:

thirdParty.title: 2.3 Data from Third Parties
thirdParty.description: If you sign in using Google or Apple, we receive your name, email, and profile picture as permitted by your settings. We do not access any other data from these services.

whyCollect.title: 3. Why Do We Collect Your Data?
whyCollect.description: We use your data for the following purposes:

features.purpose: Providing study features and saving your content

responding.purpose: Responding to your questions or feedback

updates.purpose: Sending important updates about the service

storage.title: 4. How Do We Store Your Data?
storage.description: Your data is stored securely on servers located within the European Union. We use industry-standard security measures including:

measures.https: HTTPS encryption for all data transfers
measures.hashing: Secure password hashing (never stored in plain text)
measures.access: Access controls limiting who can view your data

storage.disclaimer: While we take security seriously, no system is 100% secure. We encourage you to use a strong, unique password for your STUDO account.

retention.title: 5. How Long Do We Keep Your Data?

content.period: Until you delete them or your account

retention.deletion: When you delete your account, we remove your personal data within 30 days. Some anonymized data may be retained for analytics purposes.

sharing.title: 6. Do We Share Your Data?
sharing.description: We do <bold>not</bold> sell your personal data. We may share data only in these situations:

situations.providers: <bold>Service providers:</bold> Trusted companies that help us run STUDO (hosting, email delivery), bound by strict data protection agreements
situations.legal: <bold>Legal requirements:</bold> If required by law, court order, or to protect our rights
situations.consent: <bold>With your consent:</bold> If you explicitly agree to share data with a third party

sharing.compliance: All third-party processors we use are GDPR-compliant and based in the EU or in countries with adequate data protection.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.description: STUDO uses cookies to keep you logged in and remember your preferences. We use:

types.essential: <bold>Essential cookies:</bold> Required for the app to function (authentication, session)
types.preference: <bold>Preference cookies:</bold> Remember your settings (dark mode, language)
types.analytics: <bold>Analytics cookies:</bold> Help us understand how STUDO is used (anonymized)

cookies.manage: You can manage cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent STUDO from working properly.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights Under GDPR
rights.description: As a user in the EU, you have the following rights:

list.access: <bold>Access:</bold> Request a copy of your personal data
list.erasure: <bold>Erasure:</bold> Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
list.restriction: <bold>Restriction:</bold> Limit how we process your data
list.portability: <bold>Portability:</bold> Receive your data in a portable format
list.withdraw: <bold>Withdraw consent:</bold> Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent

rights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at <link>support@studo.study</link>. We will respond within 30 days.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.description: STUDO is intended for users aged 16 and older. If you are under 16, you need permission from a parent or guardian to use STUDO. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 16 without parental consent.
children.discovery: If we discover that we have collected data from a child under 16 without proper consent, we will delete it promptly. Parents can contact us at <link>support@studo.study</link>.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.notify: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make significant changes, we will notify you by email or through a notice on the app. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when the policy was last revised.
changes.acceptance: Continued use of STUDO after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.description: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your rights, contact us:
contact.complaint: If you believe we have not handled your data correctly, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority:
